items.title: E-Commerce Services — Microservices-based E-commerce Backend
items.description: A full-stack e-commerce service with a microservices architecture, including product catalog, shopping cart, order management and notification services.
highlights: Designed a backend platform with 7 business microservices, API Gateway, Config Server, and Eureka for identity, catalog, inventory, orders, payments, and notifications.
Implemented event-driven communication with Kafka, using transactional outbox and idempotency patterns; integrated Elasticsearch for product search.
Applied JWT-based authentication and inter-service access controls; containerized services with Docker Compose and configured CI with CircleCI.

items.title: Internship Management System — Backend REST API
items.description: A backend REST API for managing internship workflows, including student and mentor profiles, internship phases, assignments, evaluations, and scoring.
highlights: Developed a REST API for managing internship workflows, including student and mentor profiles, internship phases, assignments, evaluations, and scoring.
Implemented JWT authentication and role-based access control (RBAC) for ADMIN, MENTOR, and STUDENT, with access restrictions based on user roles and assignments.
Built the data-access layer with Spring Data JPA and PostgreSQL; applied Bean Validation, schema validation, and H2 for testing.
Added request-correlated logging with traceId and avoided exposing sensitive information in access logs.

items.title: Learning Management System (LMS) - Console application
items.description: A console application for managing learning workflows, including student and instructor profiles, course phases, assignments, evaluations, and scoring.
highlights: Built a layered Presentation–Service–DAO application to separate user interaction, business logic, and database access.
Implemented course, student, and enrollment management, including search, sorting, and enrollment approval/rejection workflows.
Added Admin/Student role-based access, BCrypt password hashing, input validation, and enrollment ownership/status checks.
Designed PostgreSQL schemas, constraints, indexes, and PL/pgSQL stored procedures/functions; implemented course enrollment statistics and rankings.
Integrated Java with PostgreSQL using JDBC and CallableStatement.

items.title: AI-Based Smart Cooking Assistant
items.description: An intelligent cooking assistant combining fine-tuned transformer computer vision models with a RAG pipeline for real-time food ingredient recognition and contextual recipe recommendations.
highlights: Crawled, cleaned, and labeled a dataset of ~14,000 food images for ingredient recognition
Fine-tuned YOLO for real-time high-accuracy food-ingredient detection
Engineered a RAG-based recipe recommendation system using LangChain
